subject: Spontaneous application – Data Engineering Internship | Veolia (Paris)
body:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am reaching out with a spontaneous application for a Data Engineering internship at Veolia in Paris. I am a Master's student in Computer Science (2024–2026) with hands-on experience developing Python scripts and writing SQL queries during a 2025 internship. I am motivated to contribute to data initiatives in the Environment sector and to learn within your teams.

I remain at your disposal for an interview.

Best regards,
John Doe
Paris | +33 6 00 00 00 00 | john@example.com

letter.name: John Doe
letter.subject: Spontaneous application – Data Engineering Internship
body: I am writing to express my interest in a Data Engineering internship at Veolia in Paris. Your activities in the Environment sector align with my academic path and my motivation to support data-driven initiatives.

Currently pursuing a Master en informatique (2024–2026) at Université Exemple, I have developed practical skills in Python and SQL, notably during a 2025 development internship where I created Python scripts and wrote SQL queries. I would like to apply these skills, together with my familiarity with Linux, to support your data engineering efforts.
I would welcome the opportunity to discuss my application with you.
